## Parts

- MAXterra Bumper: Known for silver vein powder coating and optional tire carriers; priced around $400 shipped. [t180]
- Shrockworks Rear Bumper: Priced around $800, known for quality construction and integrated hi-lift mounts. [t180]

## Tips & gotchas

- Check local fabrication shops like GetSome Fabrication (Meridian, ID) for custom rear setups with heim joints or gas can holders. [t180]
- Consider buying used Hummer H2 tire carriers from junkyards if you want a heavy-duty option at a lower cost. [t180]
